authorized_scope: prespecify a burned on-track tactical annotation calibration sample independent of candidate-model performance
inspect public race-process video or equivalent race-process evidence for tactical-event annotation only
define and mechanically validate event annotation records and eligible-event denominators
estimate tactical event-rate ranges only after actual annotations and quality checks exist
continue PRE/Expected-Line snapshots and other non-outcome Reality calibration work
still_prohibited: using finish order as a model target or feature-selection signal
causal finish-effect fitting from the tactical annotation sample
promoting Expected Line to LEGSHOW observed without direct evidence
burn_rule: Every race inspected for on-track tactical calibration is permanently BURNED and excluded from untouched validation.
principle: Observe race process to calibrate tactical mechanics, not to optimize candidate models or infer betting value.
